name: Tasneem Hossain

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Tasneem Hossain is a Bangladeshi poet who writes in English, Bangla and Urdu, with work extending into fiction, translation and essays. Her poetry books include “The Pearl Necklace”, “Floating Feathers” and “Grass in Green”. Publisher biographies connect her literary work with a background in English language and literature and communication training at the Continuing Education Centre.

“The World in My Hands” makes the bodily cost of care visible through scarred hands, tired knees and sleepless eyes. Its speaker insists that ageing has not exhausted her inward life. Another contribution, presented in Pradip Biswal’s Odia adaptation, asks for companionship before the curtain of life closes. Together, the poems place affection in present acts of attention rather than belated expressions of grief.
